exact_scope.question: Does the R-552 finite source-compatible derivative gap force an anchored-n compact-time correlation gap under the existing PAH evidence?
exact_scope.finite_input: R-552 records two source-compatible finite derivatives 2 exp(-2) and exp(-2), with finite gap exp(-2)>0 and no anchored-n limit.
exact_scope.compact_time_bound: For 0<=t<=T, 0<=C_0(t)-C_r(t)<=T*r/2; hence both oracle families converge uniformly to the same identity target as n grows.
exact_scope.scope: The oracle is a logical non-implication witness only; it is not a PAH carrier, PAH rate choice or PAH counterexample.

finding: The finite R-552 derivative gap alone does not imply an anchored-n negative. It can shrink geometrically while compact-time correlations converge uniformly to a common target. The current PAH evidence therefore lacks a source-specific n-uniform local Gibbs lower bound and a uniform derivative/remainder estimate needed to promote finite separation.
assumptions: The three parent source bytes remain at their pinned hashes.
The abstract two-state oracle is evaluated only as a reversible logical diagnostic with external diagnostic time.
The compact-time envelope uses the elementary inequality 1-exp(-x)<=x for x>=0.
missing_assumptions: Source-owner root multiplicity, duplicate-transition behavior and root counting measure.
A source-authorized n-uniform positive local correlation gap or a lower-bound mechanism preventing gap collapse.
A source-authorized uniform derivative/remainder estimate that yields a fixed compact-time separation.
R-557 common realization, N1, N2b, N2c/N4, N2d, full-domain J and anchored D fields.

adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the exact oracle has a positive gap for every n but the gap tends to zero.

adversarial_review.objection: The oracle silently changes PAH time or rates.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: it is explicitly abstract diagnostic data and the PAH definitions remain hash-pinned and untouched.

adversarial_review.objection: Uniform convergence of the oracle is evidence for the PAH target.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the oracle target is an identity semigroup and is not identified with R-512 or a PAH carrier.

adversarial_review.objection: The result proves a universal PAH no-go.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: it establishes only a logical non-implication; an owner-fixed source may still supply a uniform gap.

closed_scoped_gate: The finite R-552 derivative gap is insufficient by itself to establish an anchored-n compact-time gap; the exact missing uniform inputs are now isolated.
